bullets.text: A 14-year-old in Thailand killed his grandparents and five teachers in a shooting incident at his home and school.
Spain will impose border controls against Italy due to an intensifying dispute over a recent influx of approximately 78,000 migrants from Morocco into the Spanish exclave of Ceuta.
Nigerian security forces have rescued over 300 hostages in what is described as the largest single-day recovery operation, freeing captives held in the Kainji Lake national park.
The Australian Bureau of Statistics is deploying field officers to services assisting people experiencing homelessness to ensure everyone is counted in the upcoming Census.
Prime Minister Albanese faces a rekindled debate on gambling regulations as an inquiry into proposed crackdowns on wagering advertising garners significant attention.
The US Senate has confirmed former Republican congressman David Brat as the new ambassador to Australia, filling a diplomatic vacancy that has persisted for nearly two years.
The US economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July, a lacklustre figure that prompted traders to scale back bets on further Federal Reserve rate rises.
The dollar fell to its lowest level since May as soft US labor data reduced expectations for near-term Federal Reserve interest rate hikes.
African countries are increasingly moving away from the dollar, with the Chinese yuan and local currencies poised to benefit from this shift.
